transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

I guess… my eating’s been kind of messed up lately. Some days I barely remember to eat, and then other nights I’m up late just going through takeout or snacks. It got weird enough that I figured I should come in.
Have you lost a significant amount of weight recently?

I don’t know if it’s been a big weight loss, exactly. I haven’t really checked. It’s more that my appetite’s been all over the place—some days I just forget to eat, and then other nights I’m up after midnight eating takeout or snacks.
Are you afraid of gaining weight?
Not really. I mean, I don’t think that’s what it is. I haven’t been focused on my weight like that.
Do you ever eat a large amount of food in a short period of time, like within an hour?

Yeah… sometimes at night. I wouldn’t know if it’s exactly within an hour, but after midnight I’ll kind of tear through takeout or snacks pretty fast. Other days I forget meals completely, so it’s just… all over the place.
Do you feel guilty after eating a large amount of food in a short period of time?
I don’t know… not really guilty, I guess. Maybe kind of annoyed with myself sometimes, but I don’t think about it that much.
Do you usually eat more when you're feeling stressed or upset?

Yeah… maybe. It’s not always stress exactly. My eating’s just been all over the place — some days I forget meals, and then other nights I’m up after midnight going through takeout or snacks. That kind of scared me a little.
Do you think your eating helps you deal with difficult emotions?

Maybe… I don’t know if it helps exactly. It’s more like my eating’s just been all over the place. Some days I forget meals completely, and then other nights I’m up after midnight tearing through takeout or snacks. That’s honestly part of what scared me into coming in.
Do you feel like eating helps you when you're feeling upset or overwhelmed?

I don’t know if it helps, exactly. It’s more that my eating is just… kind of all over the place. Some days I don’t eat much at all, and then other nights I’m up after midnight going through takeout or snacks. That’s part of what freaked me out.
Do you think you eat more when you're feeling upset or overwhelmed?

Yeah… sometimes, I guess. It’s not always because I’m upset, but my eating’s been really off. Some days I just forget to eat, and other nights I’m up after midnight going through takeout or snacks. That’s kind of what scared me.
Do you think eating helps you feel better when you're upset?

Maybe for a minute, but not really. It’s more like… my eating’s just been all over the place. Some days I skip meals without meaning to, and then other nights I’m up after midnight going through takeout or snacks. That’s the part that kind of scared me.
Do you think you use eating as a way to try to feel better when you're upset or overwhelmed?

Kind of, maybe. I don’t really think of it like I’m doing it to feel better… it’s just my eating’s been all over the place. Some days I forget meals completely, and then other nights I’m up after midnight tearing through takeout and snacks. That’s honestly what scared me.
Do you think eating helps you cope with your emotions at all?

I don’t know if it helps me cope, exactly. It’s more… my eating’s just been really off. Some days I forget meals completely, and then other nights I’m up after midnight going through takeout and snacks. That’s kind of what made me come in.
Do you feel like you have control over what or how much you eat on those nights when you're up late having takeout or snacks?

Not really, no. Once I’m up that late and I start, it kind of gets away from me. That’s part of what scared me… it’s either I forget to eat at all, or I’m tearing through takeout and snacks after midnight.
Do you feel like you're unable to stop eating once you start on those late nights?
Yeah… sometimes it feels like that. Once I’m into the takeout or snacks after midnight, I don’t really stop the way I should. It’s just been all over the place.
Do you feel like you're eating because you can't stop yourself, rather than because you're hungry?

Yeah… I mean, I don’t always know if it’s hunger. Some days I just forget to eat completely, and then other nights I’m up after midnight kind of tearing through takeout and snacks. That’s what freaked me out enough to come in.
Do you feel like you're eating in response to an emotional need or because you genuinely can't control your eating?

I don’t know if I’d call it emotional exactly. It’s more like… my eating’s just been really off. Some days I forget meals completely, and then other nights I’m up after midnight going through takeout and snacks. That’s what kind of scared me.
Do you feel like you're eating because you can't control yourself or because of an emotional reason?

I don’t really know which one it is. It’s more that my eating’s been all over the place… some days I just forget meals, and then other nights I’m up after midnight going through takeout and snacks. That’s what kind of scared me.
Do you think you would be able to stop eating once you start on those late nights if you really wanted to?
I don’t know. It feels like I should be able to, but on those nights I just sort of keep going… takeout, snacks, whatever’s there. It’s part of what scared me, honestly.
Have you noticed any significant change in your weight since your eating patterns changed?

I haven’t really checked the number much. It’s more that my appetite’s been all over the place… like I’ll forget meals some days, then other nights I’m up after midnight going through takeout and snacks. That’s what got me worried.
Do you think your eating at night is more because you feel like you can't stop or because you're trying to deal with feelings?

I’m not sure it’s really about feelings. It’s more like… my eating’s just been off. Some days I don’t eat much or forget meals, and then other nights after midnight I’m going through takeout and snacks. That’s the part that scared me.
